title: Odile and the Hymn
author: Casper Reyes
blurb: Yara Vane, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
